% Three pages with different sizes; page 3 carries /Rotate 90. Each page
% shows a black rule (no fonts, to keep the PDF small).
% Built with plain pdfTeX by ../regenerate.sh (reproducible: no dates / IDs).
\pdfinfoomitdate=1
\pdftrailerid{}
\pdfsuppressptexinfo=-1
\pdfcompresslevel=9
\pdfobjcompresslevel=2
\nopagenumbers
\parindent=0pt
\hoffset=-1in \voffset=-1in
\def\page#1#2#3{%
  \pdfpagewidth=#1bp \pdfpageheight=#2bp
  \hsize=#1bp \vsize=#2bp
  \vbox to #2bp{\vss\hbox to #1bp{\hss\vrule width #3bp height 10bp\hss}\vss}\eject}
\page{300}{400}{1}
\page{400}{300}{2}
\pdfpageattr{/Rotate 90}
\page{200}{100}{3}
\bye
